findings.title: Avoid applying fixes twice to views of the same checkout
findings.description: When multiple worktree records resolve to the same filesystem root—for example, a worktree without `worktreePath`, which falls back to the project root—`buildAttributedViews` still creates a view for each record. This branch treats findings from both views as owned because their roots match, so `applyFixPlan` can apply the same fix twice to the same files and overcount `fixed` and `fixLog`. Deduplicate views by checkout root before planning, or ensure each physical checkout receives each fix only once.

findings.title: Rollback can erase edits made after the readiness check
findings.description: For non-invoking checkouts, readiness is checked immediately before applying fixes, but a concurrent edit can still occur before a commit failure triggers `restorePathsToHead`. That helper restores the entire target path to `HEAD`, potentially deleting the concurrent edit and its staged state. Preserve the pre-write state and roll back only this operation’s changes, or otherwise avoid a destructive whole-path restore in this race.
